page.name: content/counter
page.note: Created on 2026-10-14 with figma.createPage() and inserted after actions/button (144:2); holds the master and its specification.

componentSet.name: Counter
componentSet.defaultVariant: Size=md, Overflow=false (top-left of the set: Figma takes the top-left variant as the default)

Overflow text#149:13.boundIn: Overflow=true variants (Value layer): the maximum followed by a plus sign; edit it for another maximum

Overflow.note: Boolean-valued variant property, shown as a switch in Figma; the contract's derived state overflow.

layers.Container: the variant component itself (auto layout, no fill)
layers.Tint: filled rectangle (content color at opacity/tint), absolute, SCALE constraints, under the Value; the former Border (stroke-only) converted in place on 2026-10-14

Container.minWidth: typography/indicator/{size}/lineHeight (same variable: minimum width equal to the height)

Value.textStyle: typography/indicator/{size} applied by the builder, detached by the leading trim (a text-style property) on 2026-10-14; the node keeps direct bindings
Value.leadingTrim: CAP_HEIGHT (since 2026-10-14: digits centered on their cap height, as the code's text-box trim)
Value.lineHeight: typography/indicator/{size}/lineHeight (VariableID:145:6 / 145:9 / 145:12; re-bound on 2026-10-14 after the style detached)
Value.openTypeFeatures: not settable through the Plugin API (read-only); tnum read on the sm and md layers (set by the user on the styles before they detached), default on lg; Inter renders tabular figures in the file (00, 11, 88, 10 all 16 px at md)

Tint.strokes: none (the former inside stroke and its border/width/default weights were removed on 2026-10-14)
Tint.opacity: opacity/tint (Foundations · Brand, VariableID:186:3, = 12): opacity variables are synced in percent since 2026-10-14

counter/foreground.value: alias color/content/primary (Foundations · Appearance, VariableID:7:10) in the three modes
counter/foreground.note: Stands for the inherited content color; the Button overrides the Value fill and Tint fill of its Counter instance with button/foreground (VariableID:90:13). Formerly VariableID:149:1549 in _ggbrick counter (deleted 2026-10-14).

specification.documentationComponents: _Spec/Board 113:17 (fills reused), _Spec/Callout 115:6 (property Number#115:0), _Spec/Marker 115:8, Wireframe collection VariableCollectionId:105:1565 (modes light 105:0, blueprint 126:0)

temporary: Parity frames named “_parity <context>” are created at x=-4000 and removed by each measurement run (authoring/adapters/figma/counter-parity.plugin.js); experiment clones named “_experiment …” were removed in the same script that created them; none remain.
limitations: openTypeFeatures is read-only in the Plugin API: tabular figures were switched on by hand by the user on the typography/indicator text styles (2026-10-14); the sm and md Value layers read tnum, lg reads the default, and the measured digit widths at md are all 16 px (tabular rendering).
A Figma text layer's auto height is rounded to whole pixels (16 for a 15.4 line height), so the container height is bound to the lineHeight variable instead of hugging the text.
STRETCH constraints on an absolute child round the master's fractional width; the Tint uses SCALE constraints, which keep it equal to the box in every instance.

Leading trim is a text-style property: setting leadingTrim on the Value layers detached their typography/indicator text style and dropped the lineHeight binding the style carried; the six typography and fill bindings were set on the nodes (2026-10-14).

A number variable bound to layer opacity is read as a percentage: the token sync emits opacity variables ×100 (opacity/tint = 12); the former mirror variable counter/border-opacity (VariableID:158:250) was removed on 2026-10-14.

maintenance.change: Tint instead of border (user decision on the implementation review page, "Je crois que je préfère la version 'BG Current color' à 12%"): the six Border rectangles (149:1552, 149:1555, 149:1558, 149:1561, 149:1564, 149:1567) were converted in place into Tint layers (fill bound to counter/foreground, no stroke, stroke weight bindings removed, layer opacity bound to the new opacity/tint VariableID:186:3 = 12, radii and SCALE constraints kept); counter/foreground scopes TEXT_FILL and SHAPE_FILL. Cap-height centering: leadingTrim CAP_HEIGHT on the six Value texts (149:1551, 149:1554, 149:1557, 149:1560, 149:1563, 149:1566), which detached their text style; lineHeight re-bound to typography/indicator/{size}/lineHeight. Set description, specification texts (summary 156:4871, legend 156:4943 and 156:4951, Button note 156:5554) and the anatomy diagram (3 Tint 156:4908 and Tint (one digit) 156:4911 filled under the dashed containers 156:4903 and 156:4909) updated in place. In the Button, the three trailing Counter instances (164:1545, 164:1549, 164:1553) had their stroke override cleared and the Tint fill bound to button/foreground; the 18 Tint layers of the page audit all read button/foreground, no stroke, opacity/tint. Parity re-measured: 1692 records, 0 failed, 144 justified, 72 proxy; the Counter boxes inside the Button keep their size (15.4, 16.8, 19.6 px), so the slot geometry of 2026-10-14 stands.

Blueprint boards: the drawing is centered vertically in each board and the legend elements follow (user review of the wave 1 Figma parity gate, 2026-10-14); the builder script applies the same pass (centerBoards).

Adapter collections regrouped (user review, 2026-10-14): the component adapter variables now live in one hidden collection Components (VariableCollectionId:181:2, modes sm 181:0, md 181:1, lg 181:2, default md): button/icon-drawing 181:3, button/icon-size 181:4, counter/foreground 181:5, shortcut/foreground 181:6, shortcut/font-size 181:7, shortcut/line-height 181:8, shortcut/letter-spacing 181:9, shortcut/cap-min-width 181:10 (size-independent variables carry the same alias in the three modes). Every consumer was rebound and the explicit size modes moved (Button: 564 bindings, 138 mode assignments; Shortcut: 13 bindings, 12 modes; Counter: 12 paints; stale Leading icon overrides on ten specification instances reset and re-applied); the collections _ggbrick button size (74:3), _ggbrick shortcut size (149:1570), _ggbrick counter (149:1548) and _ggbrick shortcut (149:1571) were deleted with no reference left on any page. _ggbrick button style and _ggbrick button state were renamed Components · button style (90:12) and Components · button state (90:2), IDs unchanged, hidden. Checks: the eight variables resolve to the former values in each mode; Button slot geometry re-measured with icon, counter and shortcut trailing items (162 records, 0 failures).

Token collections renamed Foundations · Primitives, Foundations · Brand, Foundations · Appearance and Foundations · Density (IDs and bindings unchanged); the adapter scripts of this component resolve the short axis names to the prefixed ones.

Internal part _Counter/Nested (278:261) and the adapter variables counter/* created (authoring/adapters/figma/nested-parts.plugin.js). User decision at the wave 1 Figma parity review (2026-10-26, option 2): inside a host, a Counter or Shortcut must not show its Size; Counter and Shortcut keep their Size for use on their own. Equal to Counter in 18 contexts × 3 sizes × 2 overflow states except the lg digits: the Counter lg master lacks tabular figures (limitation above), the nested part has them like the code, so an lg value can be 1 px wider. Counter itself is unchanged apart from its description, which points to the nested part.

Library pages (user decision): the master and its internal parts moved to the section Counter of the Content library page (IDs kept, instances linked; library-pages.plugin.js); the component page keeps the specification, which now links to the section (spec-master-links.plugin.js).

Library page layout (user request): the Content page opens with the overview frame (372:319: description, isometric cover, a card per component); the section Counter starts with a Section header (372:1131: summary, specification link, properties) and the master sits under it, its internal parts on its right (_Counter/Nested packed into a tight grid, variant order kept) (family-pages.plugin.js; IDs of the masters unchanged). The specification's link to the master moved to the top right of the title row (373:23; spec-header-links.plugin.js, replacing spec-master-links.plugin.js); Documentation and Contract links follow at the first publication.
